read_first: world-event registry only when an event lifecycle or persisted consequence is causally relevant
only referenced process/mechanics needed to resolve change
for a consequential site question, verify compact place state is sufficient before resolution
write_order: validate cause, authority, elapsed time and information limits
settle any causally relevant site operational module through the exact reached time
instantiate a scheduled or active world-event record before resolving a material autonomous operation
write authoritative world, place, faction or other domain consequences before marking the event terminal
write separate personnel, force, stock, inventory or process owners only when their own authority actually changes
write witness, audience, knowledge and route references only after their dedicated information authorities support delivery
transition the event lifecycle only after affected-owner, material-consequence, visibility, reducer, transaction and receipt references exist
rebuild affected indexes and process consequences
invariants: Offscreen world state changes only through registered processes or resolved causal actions.
World-event IDs are stable and unique; lifecycle time fields remain chronological and status-consistent.
Cold archetypes may be referenced as provenance but are never copied into mutable state as unresolved templates.
The event registry records lifecycle, causal scope and provenance; referenced domain owners and receipts remain authority for material outcomes.
Terminal events resolve affected-owner and material-consequence references and retain reducer reference, transaction and receipt provenance.
World ownership/control/resources are never inferred from labels or indexes.
Player and NPC knowledge remain separate from world truth; visibility classification alone grants no knowledge.
Event display_summary text is non-authoritative and never supplies mechanics, status, visibility or consequences.
Any world object capable of changing a consequential outcome must have sufficient authoritative state for that causal role or route to registered deeper authority before resolution.
Missing site detail is never silently treated as neutral, favorable, hostile or retroactively selected after a plan is revealed.
Static ambient locations establish ontology only and never imply mutable security, staff, supply, capacity, damage, access or readiness.
Strategic places persist only applicable causal modules; detailed personnel, formations, stock, inventory and mechanics remain separate authorities referenced rather than duplicated.
